action_items: Add data-testid attributes to modal action buttons and inputs in AdminStudentForm.jsx (price update modal) and AdminTeacherForm.jsx (price update modal) for stable UI automation. Examples: data-testid='student-price-input', data-testid='student-valid-from-input', data-testid='student-price-save-btn', data-testid='teacher-price-birebir-input', data-testid='teacher-price-save-btn'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 7676-7680: Duplicate '$or' key in dict literal for student price conflict detection - second 'valid_from' inside dict replaces first (Python dict literal behavior). The intent appears to be 'check if valid_from of existing record falls between provided valid_from and valid_to', but only the second key is honored. Low impact since conflict detection function is not called in POST endpoint (it's only declared), but should be cleaned up.

server.py POST /student-price-history (line 7715) does NOT call check_price_conflict before insert, so date-range overlaps are possible. Only the same-period (valid_to=None) record is closed. This may be intentional for backdating, but should be documented.
server.py line 7773 and 7867: new_price.pop('_id', None) is called but _id was never added since UUID id was used; safe but redundant.

Frontend AdminStudentForm.jsx line 267: lessonType is 'group' when course.group_id exists, else 'birebir'. Correct logic but should verify the lesson_type stored in history matches the lesson_type used by get_student_price_at_date during balance calc.
Action button 'Fiyatı Güncelle' inside student price modal has no data-testid - hurts test stability.
server.py line 8093 file is 8093 lines - exceeds 700-line maintainability threshold. Recommend modular split into routers (students.py, teachers.py, lessons.py, finance.py, price_history.py).
